request.style: English, female voice, warm and narrative, solo with acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drums, hopeful and dramatic, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A servant came from Saul's old house
Named Ziba standing in the dust
The king asked if any kin remained
Of Jonathan's line in this land
A son with feet that could not walk
Living far away from the ark

[Chorus]
The donkeys loaded with the bread
Two hundred loaves are spread
Raisins and fruit for the men
Wine for the faint in the wilderness then
Everything that belongs to Mephibosheth
Is now yours to claim and to possess

[Verse]
David fled when Absalom rose
Ziba met him with a show
He said the master stayed behind
To take the kingdom from the mind
So the king gave all the estate
To Ziba who bowed before the great

[Chorus]
The donkeys loaded with the bread
Two hundred loaves are spread
Raisins and fruit for the men
Wine for the faint in the wilderness then
Everything that belongs to Mephibosheth
Is now yours to claim and to possess

[Bridge]
But Mephibosheth came down low
His feet untrimmed and clothes worn
He said my servant lied to you
He left me lame and without a clue
I am like an angel's friend
Do whatever seems good in the end

[Chorus]
The donkeys loaded with the bread
Two hundred loaves are spread
Raisins and fruit for the men
Wine for the faint in the wilderness then
Everything that belongs to Mephibosheth
Is now yours to claim and to possess

[Outro]
So you and Ziba shall divide
The land that they are to abide
Divide the land and be done
The story of the servant son
